title: Bess A
content: I was eight years old in London. My mother and aunt and I were leaving a restaurant. My mother was driving home. It was late, and I fell asleep. I remember hearing a deep thud. It was a black taxi hitting our small Citroën. Next, I remember waking up in an ambulance. I was cold and uncomfortable, so tried to move. The paramedics covered me with a blanket. I reached out and found my knee right beside my right ear. Then I felt my foot beside my left ear. I started to panic, and the paramedics put me to sleep. I had broken my right femur, and my leg was twisted behind my head. Next, I remember two beings looking at me from above. I was lying down. They asked me telepathically if I wanted to go back. I wasn’t scared. I said that I wanted to go back. They asked me if I was sure. I said I wanted to have babies and a family. One being warned me that it would be painful to go back. I said I wanted to return regardless. I felt hopeful. The two beings looked at each other, and one nodded as a sign of approval. I felt pulled backward, and then opened my eyes. I was on a stretcher covered with a blanket and a nurse was looking at me. As soon as I opened my eyes, she looked into them. She moved to call another nurse who immediately came. I looked to my right, and my aunt was on a stretcher. We were in the emergency ward. I was given anesthesia and taken to surgery. The rest is history. I am the mother of two beautiful beings and have a loving family.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Accident, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, The sounds of the communication were deeper. There was vastness beyond, but the beings were close to me.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I saw the two beings, I experienced consciousness and alertness. It was like natural alertness. But it felt different because it was more intense.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, There was no time.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: The vision seemed very real, perhaps more real than everyday vision. There seemed to be white-blue light coming from the beings.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, I was lying down but floating at the same time. All around me was dark except for the light radiating from the beings. When I was pulled back, I opened my eyes and entered an earthly realm. It had hospital lighting but felt different because it had different lighting.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I am interested in NDEs.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, As a child, I had no particular understanding of beliefs.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I have witnessed that there are beings beyond the earthly realm that care for me.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, My entire experience was my interaction with the two beings I have described.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, I was to have children. It was my purpose and desire.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I wanted to have babies and become a mother. It was a genuine little girl's desire of heart.
Uncertain, It was a very brief conversation with the beings. They seemed to watch over me but I just exchanged some words. It was clear that the question was if I wanted to "go back" to my body.
Yes, A being told me it would be painful to go back. The one on the right. The one on the left gave a nod of approval for me to go back.
Yes, I wanted to love my children.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I am alive. As a result of my severe disability after the accident, I learned to play piano as I could not play with other children. This became my activity. I now play at an advanced classical level. I teach, and it is a very important part of my spiritual and personal life.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, As a child, I just accepted the experience as natural. But as an adult, I now understand that this was an extraordinary experience.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, Nine to ten months prior to the NDE event, my nine-year-old brother was killed in Colombia. My mother and I had to leave in exile to London, UK. My brother's passing and the sudden exile were traumatic events, so I remember the events of my life at that time very clearly.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I have heard voices that warned me of danger. I have also dreamt of children that were to be born.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: My children are a very significant part of my life. That was the only reason I wanted to return.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, As a child, I just accepted my reality as it came.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, It is a very clear childhood memory with no judgment or preconceptions.
